verdict.rationale: Cold-start time is a fair axis for a local inference runtime, but the evidence never addresses startup latency or binary size. The documented strengths are a small RAM footprint through SSD expert streaming and decode throughput from routing prediction. The main documented workflow runs through a Python venv, and the macOS Rust CLI/daemon is only listed as a platform, with no startup-speed claim.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can get a fast cold start from a lightweight runtime binary instead of waiting seconds before inference begins
